jp: 明日[あした]{の|no-possessive}会議[かいぎ]{は/が|wa-topic}何時[なんじ]{から|kara-from}だ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: What time does tomorrow's meeting start again?
why: You are searching memory for a detail you once knew, which is what っけ marks; after だ it cannot be かな or の.

jp: あの映画[えいが]{の|no-possessive}題名[だいめい]{は/が|wa-topic}何[なん]だ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: What was the title of that movie again?
why: The speaker half-remembers the title and asks for it again, so だっけ fits; だよね or だぞ cannot follow 何.

jp: 田中[たなか]さん{の|no-possessive}誕生日[たんじょうび]{は/が|wa-topic}来月[らいげつ]だ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: Mr. Tanaka's birthday is next month, isn't it? I can't quite remember.
why: The speaker vaguely remembers the date and wants it confirmed; っけ follows だ here, but かな and の cannot.

jp: 今日[きょう]{は|wa-topic}何曜日[なんようび]だ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: What day of the week is it today, again?
why: Forgetting a fact you normally know is the job of っけ; だかな, だの and だ+さ are not sentences.

jp: 鍵[かぎ]{を|o-object}どこ{に|ni-location}置[お]いた{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: Where did I put my key again?
why: The speaker is trying to remember a past action, so たっけ fits; ぞ, さ and わ are statements and cannot follow どこ.

jp: この漢字[かんじ]{は|wa-topic}どう読[よ]むんだ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: How do you read this kanji again?
why: A reading you once knew and cannot retrieve is asked with っけ; ぞ, さ and わ make statements, which clash with どう.

jp: 駅[えき]{まで|made-until}歩[ある]いて何分[なんぷん]かかるんだ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: How many minutes does it take to walk to the station, again?
why: You are retrieving a number you once knew, so っけ; the statement particles cannot follow 何分.

jp: あの人[ひと]{の|no-possessive}名前[なまえ]{は/が|wa-topic}何[なん]だった{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: What was that person's name again?
why: Past-form だったっけ asks about something you knew and have forgotten; ぞ, さ and よね cannot follow 何.

jp: 傘[かさ]{は|wa-topic}ちゃんと持[も]ってきた{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: Did I remember to bring my umbrella? I can't recall.
why: The speaker cannot recall whether they did something, so たっけ; ぞ, さ and わ would turn it into a statement that they brought it.

jp: 田中[たなか]さん{は|wa-topic}何歳[なんさい]だ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: How old is Mr. Tanaka again?
why: Recalling a known fact takes っけ after だ; かな and の do not attach to だ here.

jp: 先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}何[なん]{と|to-quote}言[い]っていた{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: What did the teacher say again?
why: The speaker tries to recall words once heard, so っけ; ぞ, さ and わ are statement endings and clash with 何.

jp: 富士山[ふじさん]{の|no-possessive}高[たか]さ{は/が|wa-topic}何[なん]メートルだ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: How many metres tall is Mount Fuji again?
why: A figure you once learned and forgot is asked with っけ; かな, の and ぞ cannot follow メートルだ in this question.

jp: 昨日[きのう]{は|wa-topic}何[なに]{を|o-object}食[た]べた{っけ|kke-recall}？

why: You are trying to recall your own recent past with たっけ; ぞ, さ and わ are assertions and cannot follow 何.

jp: あの人[ひと]{は|wa-topic}誰[だれ]だ{っけ|kke-recall}？
en: Who is that person again?

jp: 次[つぎ]{の|no-possessive}電車[でんしゃ]{は/が|wa-topic}何時[なんじ]{に|ni-time}来[く]るんだ{っけ|kke-recall}？
